about: Agency park lists for kpc_agency_lists.py (the keeper calls it). One official list per agency, giving its website id and its map id. Every agency stays OFF (enabled false) until a person has filled in the official source_url, format, web_id and map, and robots.txt does not have an explicit Disallow for our path or user-agent. A licence or terms is recorded when known, but is not a gate for private matching-only use (the lists stay private, used only for matching). Never a WDPA source. Where the map record already carries the website address (NY DEC, CA State Parks, MT FWP, MN DNR forests, some NPS layers), no list is needed: those ties live in KPC-Links .github/link-id-ties.json instead. 21 Nov: every agency of the owner's research table is listed with what was found; each stays off with its reason. To switch one on, a person also sets format, web_id and map from fields confirmed on the list. robots.txt blocks only on an explicit Disallow, or a file that loaded but could not be parsed; a 403, 404 or empty robots.txt is no rules (OK). The keeper still reads robots.txt live before every fetch.

fields.agency: short name; the file is agency-crosswalk/<slug>.json
fields.link_kind: the id kind the park's POTA link carries (as kpc_match_checks ID_KINDS names it)
fields.source_url: https address of the official list
fields.licence: the licence or terms, in a few words, as the agency states it
fields.terms_url: where that licence or terms is written
fields.web_id: {column, regex?}: the column with the website id (regex group 1 when the column holds a page address)
fields.map: {layer, field, value}: the map layer and field the id is on, and the list column holding that id
fields.checked: who checked source, licence and robots.txt, and when
fields.licence_ok: true only when the licence text was read and allows our use; recorded, not a gate for private matching-only use
fields.robots: what robots.txt says for the list path. The reader blocks only on an explicit Disallow for our path or user-agent, or a file that loaded but could not be parsed. A 403, 404 or empty robots.txt is no rules (OK). The keeper still reads robots.txt live before every fetch
fields.fields_seen: research notes on the id fields (not read by the reader)
fields.status: one line: why the agency is off, or that it is on
